notable_absence.finding: The exclusion list for Health Advisor ('This feature is not available to use with Capella Analytics clusters, free tier operational clusters or operational clusters deployed with the Basic plan') names plan:basic-support-plan and plan:free-tier-plan by their exact registry labels, but names 'Capella Analytics clusters' as a third exclusion with no corresponding plan/deployment-type concept in the registry slice reviewed - Analytics clusters are excluded on cluster-type grounds, not plan grounds, so no requiresSupportPlan relation was minted for that clause specifically.

cross_component_finding: Reading Health Advisor's own page confirms last round's monitoring:health-advisor-report and monitoring:severity-level-enum cleanly with no correction needed - unlike the capella-role catalog, which prior reconciliation had to correct after reading authoritative role pages. What this page adds beyond confirmation is depth the reference page didn't carry: a concrete plan-gating hierarchy (Developer Pro or Enterprise to generate/view reports at all; Enterprise only for automatic weekly scheduling; explicit exclusion of Basic, free tier, and Analytics clusters), a 10-report retention limit ('view any of the last 10 Health Advisor reports'), and 4 named report categories (Cluster Health, Services Health, Node Health, App Services Health) not present in health-advisor-reference.json's flat table. This page does not restate the storage-engine (Couchstore/Magma) threshold split found in health-advisor-reference.json's Data Resident Ratio row - that structural detail lives only in the reference page, not the feature's own overview page.
